system.name: EBS
system.one_liner: Alibaba's cloud block storage architecture that virtualizes disks for VMs and persists data via block proxies to a distributed file system

components.name: Hypervisor
components.role: embeds a client that forwards VDs' requests to backend storage clusters

components.name: Block Proxy
components.role: receives VDs' requests and persists/fetches data to/from the distributed file system

components.name: GC Worker
components.role: garbage collection worker within a Block Proxy

components.name: Snapshot Worker
components.role: snapshot worker within a Block Proxy

components.name: LSBD
components.role: Log-Structured Block Device layer beneath the Block Proxy

components.name: Append-only File System
components.role: distributed file system (DFS) that persists each VD's data as a file

content.key_idea: EBS virtualizes disks inside VMs on compute servers; a hypervisor client forwards each virtual disk's requests to Block Proxies, which persist or fetch the data as files in a distributed append-only file system.
content.reading_order: Top-down through three labeled layers: Compute Layer (VMs and virtual disks) over Block Layer (Block Proxies) over Persistence Layer (append-only file system).

palette.used_for: outer container boxes (Compute Server, Block Proxy, Append-only File System)
inner boxes nested within them (VMs, GC/Snapshot Worker, data files)

style.font: Times New Roman serif, 7.5-10.5pt, bold for layer/box titles
style.arrows: few simple thin double-headed connectors between layers

encoding.color_means: medium gray marks the outer container boxes and light gray marks the components nested inside them; no color-coding distinguishes novel vs. existing parts since this is background context
encoding.emphasis: three explicitly labeled horizontal layers (Compute/Block/Persistence) on the left margin walk the reader top-to-bottom through the storage stack
reusable_patterns: three-tier storage stack: compute (VMs/virtual disks) over block-serving proxies over a persistence file system
weaknesses: monochrome gray palette does not visually distinguish component roles beyond nesting

summary: This figure gives background on the architecture of EBS (Elastic Block Storage), the cloud block-storage system that the paper's own contribution, DeftPunk, builds on. Three horizontal layers are labeled down the left margin. In the Compute Layer, a Compute Server hosts multiple VMs (VM#1, VM#2), each running a guestOS on top of one or more virtual disks (VD#0-VD#3); a Hypervisor embeds a client that forwards each VD's requests onward. In the Block Layer, one or more Block Proxy instances, each with a GC Worker and Snapshot Worker sitting on an LSBD (Log-Structured Block Device), receive those requests. In the Persistence Layer, an Append-only File System stores each VD's data as a separate file. All boxes use a plain two-tone gray palette, since this figure only sets up background context rather than presenting the paper's own contribution.
summary_zh: 该图展示 EBS 背景架构，分三层：计算层（虚拟机与虚拟磁盘，经 Hypervisor 转发请求）、块层（Block Proxy 含 GC/Snapshot Worker 及 LSBD）、持久层（文件系统存数据文件）。
notes: Figure 1 depicts background/existing EBS architecture rather than DeftPunk's own contribution; all components are marked novel:false accordingly.
